name: barbell core squat
description: A barbell squat focused on bracing your core hard through the lift. It builds leg strength and trunk stability.
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Take a deep breath and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your torso tight and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Exhale at the top and reset your brace each rep.
